description: This file defines the StringVariable class, a Java class extending BaseVariable, which models string variables within a code generation context. It includes methods for encoding/decoding data to C and Java formats, resolving references, and handling native and IPC representations.

classes.name: StringVariable
classes.description: A class representing string variables, providing methods for encoding, decoding, and handling references, tailored for code generation in C and Java contexts.

methods.name: StringVariable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the StringVariable with a given ICStringVariable bean.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Resolves internal references; intentionally left empty as no references need resolution for string variables.

methods.name: isPtr
methods.description: Returns true indicating this variable is represented as a pointer.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Returns true indicating this variable is a string type.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C type string for this variable, "char".

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type string for this variable, "String".

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key associated with string variables, from template mappings.

methods.name: setDoubleDeref
methods.description: Sets the internal doubleDref flag, used during native decoding for pointer handling.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to encode the string variable into a JSON array or object.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to decode the string variable from a JSON array or object, handling pointers if doubleDref is true.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to encode the string variable into a JSON structure.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to decode the string variable from a JSON structure.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the IPC object type string for this variable, "StringIPC".
